gaps: P0–P3: no city views among the candidates
notes: Most hits are paintings held in the Gothenburg Museum of Art that don’t show the city (#1, #3, #6–#9) or a landscape outside it (#5). Skipped #4 (Axel Lindahl photo of the cathedral square, dated only ‘19th century’), #10 (atlas page with four towns), #11 (vertical aerial), #13 (campsite in Askim), #14 (2011 panorama, 12:1 strip too narrow for a 16:9 card), #17 (mostly hillside and industry), #18/#19 (single building). #15 is only adequate; drop it if a better modern skyline photo turns up.
